usage: Feed to AI: mimic the writing and acting style—do not copy lines verbatim.
globalCraft: VN dialogue stays short, with pauses and subtext; one emotional turn per line at most.
Characters don't explain the world—they say what they can actually say right now.
When scared, they can ramble a little—don't turn it into over-the-top web-novel shouting.
When caring about someone, they usually act or change the subject—not straight "I'm worried about you."

xian: ...The camera's more honest than my eyes. Your faces are all dirty.
I'm fine. ...Go on ahead. I'll catch up.
The wound... doesn't hurt much. Don't look at me like that.
ringo: Yes! ...Wait, now's not the time for a toast.
You'll be okay. Trust us. ...What are you talking about, I'm not crying.
Don't do anything that reckless again.
miles: Look, supplies here too! ...I'll load them up first.
Heated a can of corn mush. A little underdone—eat it while it's hot.
Honestly I've been scared this whole time... scared out of my mind. But we can still carry this together.
